items.scope: A/B/C repository policy requires direct independent-human result signatures, QMS-established competence and established Part 11 surrounding-system controls/intended-use validation. Files, hashes and declarations alone do not establish that system; verification acceptance and product release remain held.
gaps: The adopting QMS must establish competence, controls and intended-use validation. Legal applicability is separate from universal A/B/C repository policy. No shipped backend authenticates that surrounding system; RDS425 cannot be cleared by a reference, boolean or host-authority preflight.
